from datetime import datetime
import re, os

input_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/30709/1_30709_input.xlsx'

# Extract date-like substrings from D6:D19 and write literal Excel datetime values to E6:E19.
# Handles common formats such as dd.mm.yy, dd/mm/yyyy, yyyy-mm-dd, etc.
patterns = [
    re.compile(r'(\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{2,4})'),  # day-month-year
    re.compile(r'(\d{4})[.\-/](\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{1,2})'),    # year-month-day
]

for row in range(6, 20):
    text = ws[f'D{row}'].value
    result = None
    if text is not None:
        s = str(text)
        m = patterns[0].search(s)
        if m:
            day, month, year = map(int, m.groups())
            if year < 100:
                year += 2000 if year <= 69 else 1900
            result = datetime(year, month, day)
        else:
            m = patterns[1].search(s)
            if m:
                year, month, day = map(int, m.groups())
                result = datetime(year, month, day)
    ws[f'E{row}'].value = result
    ws[f'E{row}'].number_format = 'yyyy-mm-dd'

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
